feedback: Your essay addresses the topic of cellphones in the classroom, but it needs more structure to be truly persuasive. Currently, your ideas are presented as a list of short, separate sentences. To improve, try grouping related points into paragraphs. For example, put all your points about 'fairness' in one paragraph and your points about 'classroom distractions' in another. Use linking words like 'furthermore,' 'however,' or 'consequently' to help your ideas flow together. Additionally, try to expand on your examples; instead of just saying a phone can show a picture in science, explain how that specific tool helps a learner understand a complex concept better. Focusing on these transitions and sentence variety will make your argument much stronger.
